title: FunCube Adventure RPG
description: An unique and immersive adventure for adventurers who love exploration, challenges, and additional items and dimensions !
body:
# 🎮 Welcome to the FunCube ModPack! 🌟

Get ready to dive into a **unique, one-of-a-kind RPG adventure** built to surprise you at every step:  
**exploration, quests, skills to level up, new items, mobs, blocks…** and **much more** to discover in-game! 🚀

---

## 🌍 A World Built for Adventurers

Whether you’re an **experienced explorer** or a **challenge-seeking adventurer**, FunCube offers a vast world full of possibilities:  
- ✨ Hidden secrets & unexpected discoveries  
- 🧭 Exploration-driven progression  
- ⚔️ Content designed for long adventures  

---

## 📘 Complete Documentation (Install & Setup)

I’ve prepared a detailed guide to help you install the modpack:  
- ✅ **Manual installation**  
- ✅ **CurseForge installation**  
- ✅ Main mods list included  
- ✅ Step-by-step guide for **solo play** or **your own server** 🔧

📌 **Documentation:** https://courone-owner.gitbook.io/funcube-modpacks

---

## 🌟 What’s Included in the Pack

A complete set to enhance your gaming experience:

### 🎥 Shaders (Optimized)
- Includes the famous **Complementary Shaders**
- Already configured & optimized for **low-end setups** ✅

### 🎨 Resource Packs (Refined Visuals)
- Refined textures to give a new dimension to your Minecraft world  
- Cleaner visuals, better immersion ✨

---

## 🔄 Regular Updates

I’m committed to updating the modpack regularly to add:  
- 🧩 New mods  
- 🗺️ New content & systems  
- 🚀 Improvements and surprises over time  

👉 **Best way to stay up to date?** Join our Discord to get real-time news about updates and changes!

---
